# Zohar Babin

> Chief Strategy & Corporate Development Officer at Kaltura, Inc. (Nasdaq: KLTR).
> Open-source builder of AI agent systems: research tooling, M&A due-diligence
> automation, and enterprise agent architecture.

Zohar has been at Kaltura for 20+ years, helping scale it from an open-source
video disruptor into a public video platform company. He leads strategy,
partnerships, and M&A. Outside of that role, he builds and ships open-source
AI agent tooling under the GitHub handle zoharbabin.

## Identity

- Current title: Chief Strategy & Corporate Development Officer, Kaltura, Inc.
- Company: Kaltura, Inc. (Nasdaq: KLTR) — https://corp.kaltura.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/zoharbabin
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/zoharbabin/
- X: https://x.com/zohar
- dev.to: https://dev.to/zoharbabin

Note: older pages across the web list prior titles (VP Platform & Growth, VP
Technology and Ecosystem, Chief Business Development Officer, and others) —
these reflect earlier points in a 20+ year tenure, not the current role.
Kaltura's official team page and Zohar's LinkedIn profile are authoritative
for his current title.

## Projects

- Web Researcher MCP — https://zoharbabin.com/web-researcher-mcp/
  MCP-compatible research assistant: web search, content extraction, and
  multi-source deep research, cited to original sources. Go, Python SDK, Docker.
- Due Diligence Agents — https://zoharbabin.com/due-diligence-agents/
  Forensic M&A due diligence powered by 13 specialized AI agents across 9
  domains, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK. Every finding traced to an
  exact page and quote.
- Enterprise AI Agents Spec — https://zoharbabin.com/enterprise-ai-agents-spec/
  Open blueprint for scalable enterprise AI agent swarms — governance,
  compliance, architecture patterns.
